jtbd.jtbd_desc: Prime relationships and schedule content drops to convert JCamp/London momentum into follow-on opportunities.

interactions.user_ask: How do I turn the JCamp trip into real opportunities?
interactions.jenny_reply: Pre-book 3 conversations: 1 reporter, 1 editor, 1 mentor. Send a 4-line intro with 2 specific asks and a proof link.

interactions.user_ask: What should I publish while I’m away?
interactions.jenny_reply: Schedule 3 ‘postcards’—10–20s clips with a single takeaway; one per 3–4 days. Cross-post to X/IG/YouTube Shorts.
Rotate channels and vary intent: 1 spotlight, 1 curiosity thread, 1 gratitude post. Keep each under 120 words.
Follow up in 3 business days with a single new proof—draft paragraph, 30s clip, or artifact screenshot.

outcomes.name: outreach_sequences_v1
outcomes.details: 3 sequences: reporter/editor/mentor; each has opener + follow-up.

outcomes.name: content_drop_schedule_v1
outcomes.details: Three pre-scheduled ‘postcard’ clips for the travel window.
